We have cloud at home

Reasoning

The thought about the process of parting from the giants of the web, namely Google Cloud and Apple’s iCloud, has most likely been on quite a few pondering minds. For me personally, the timing with new apartment, fiber connection and surplus hardware was enough to pique interest.

There are, ofcourse, plenty of ways to do this. Depending on your personal needs and the depth of suffering an individual is ready to push through. For me, it would be the middle ground from the pain suffering being offered. NextCloud and Immich were the first picks for the most used areas of my or the family in general.

Starting point

Fedora, NextCloud,

Extending / Headroom

Immich or alts

Managing

Docker,

Implementation

Running SFF PC with sufficient storage capacity, Fedora under the hood for now.

Works for now

The thing here, the main thing is that this should just work without a second thought and stay accessible only at home. Without any data leaving the hardware connected to our home network.
